messages:
Maya: Heads up — saw a discrepancy between Node sample-app and Python sample-app hitting /embeddings-rerank. Node returns correct vectors (len 1536) but Python intermittently gets empty vectors ([]) which triggers an NPE in our reranker. Repro below.

Alex: can you paste minimal payload and failing response?

Maya: payload from node batch helper:
```
POST /v1/embeddings-rerank
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: batch-2026-03-01-42
{ "items": [{"id":"q1","text":"What is the refund policy?"},{"id":"q2","text":"How do I set up SSO?"}], "model":"open-embed-1536" }
```

Maya: Node logs:
```
200 OK items:2 vectors:[[...1536 floats...],[...1536 floats...]]
```

Maya: Python in same run:
```
200 OK items:2 vectors:[[...1536 floats...], []]
```

Ken: looks like a retry race. Our retry middleware may replay a chunk but not preserve per-item placeholders; if a placeholder is written before replay it can result in an empty vector for that slot.

retry-bot: Retrying request id=batch-2026-03-01-42 after token refresh (attempt 2)

Elaine: two actions:
1) SDK parity — Node's batch helper sets X-Request-ID and idempotency; Python didn't. That causes different retry semantics.
2) Response handling — Python client assumes every vector slot is populated. Add validation after parsing to check non-empty and expected dim; surface clear error instead of NPE.

Alex: agree. Also add `items_index` in batch envelope so replayed chunks can be stitched by index. Add unit tests injecting empty vectors to assert SDK raises descriptive error.

Maya: patch idea for Python:
```
for i, v in enumerate(response["vectors"]):
  if not v or len(v) != 1536:
    raise ValueError(f"Embedding parity error: item {i} got vector len={len(v)}")
```

Ken: for both SDKs batch helper add: attach X-Request-ID if missing; include batch_indexes: [0,1..]; replay whole chunks and remap by index.

Maya: I'll PR sample-apps + Python SDK, Node SDK PR for index. Links forthcoming.

Elaine: verify auth refresh path — token refresh during in-flight batch can cause silent retries. Debounce refresh and let in-flight requests use previous header until explicit 401.

Alex: ops: add debug log when vec dim mismatch: `DBG vec_mismatch request_id=<id> item=<i> got=<len> expected=1536` for support triage.

Maya: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/459 (python validate vectors & tests); https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/987 (client sanity check); https://github.com/redwood/sdk-node/pull/312 (batch_indexes + idempotency)

Ken: will add e2e in staging to simulate replayed chunk with empty body to ensure SDKs error instead of returning partial vectors.

Maya: deployed python patch to staging, rerank smoke passed. Will coordinate support and backport to 1.14.x.

Elaine: please put a note in release notes about the guard and customer remediation steps.

Alex: will add note and close issues.

Maya: thanks all :thumbsup: closing after SDK rc cut.
